$comment: The ban list for telemetry field names - the single source of truth shared by the runtime guard
and the build-time gate, so the two cannot drift (TASKS.md T-SEC-004 invariant).
1. src/shared/observability/attributes.ts  -> drops and counts at runtime
tests/unit/observability/token-logging.test.ts asserts both classify the same names identically.
MATCHING: the field name is split into words on camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case boundaries
(`checkinToken` -> [checkin, token], `invitation_code` -> [invitation, code]) and a pattern matches
when it EQUALS one of those words. Substring matching was tried first and rejected: `uri` matches
favoURItE and secURIty, which would ban ordinary attributes and train people to disable the rule.
`except` lists whole names that contain a banned word but are explicitly allowed; they must also be
in ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES (src/shared/observability/attributes.ts), which the runtime asserts at startup.
The allow-list is checked before any of this, which is why `errorCode` survives `code`.
